title: Just Ok
text: Just Ok. I had high hopes for this. Our blender we usually use is old and wearing out so we got this one hoping it would be great for our smoothies and shakes on the run. Does not hold up well to solid food. Works fine for powder and milk for protein shakes but not to frozen fruit and yogurt for smoothies. After just one use you could smell the burning of the gears.
